title: CustomerSupportMessage
description: Structured representation of an unstructured customer support message.

name.description: Customer's full name. Empty string if not provided in the message.

email.description: Customer's email address. Empty string if not provided in the message.

urgency.description: Estimated urgency of the issue based on message content.

message.description: The customer's original problem, summarized or preserved without inventing new details.
